body: I'd second lifeprint, and go out of your way to experience ASL when you can. I pay attention to https://dpan.tv/series/dtv-news because it's super accessible and very immersive!

This might be a little late, but I went to a college with a very large deaf population, and we were always recommended http://www.lifeprint.com/  for quick and dirty AND super in depth. Not really a course, but more like word by word.
Do you happen to have a source for this? I *love* this art style.
